title: Cindy Blackman Santana - Wikipedia
notes: Born 18 November 1959, Yellow Springs, Ohio; Hartt School; Berklee with Alan Dawson, Tony Williams's teacher; to New York 1982; Art Blakey 'like a father'; Arcane (1987); Kravitz's drummer from 1993, eighteen years; Another Lifetime (2010); married Carlos Santana 19 December 2010; Corazón, Africa Speaks, Blessings and Miracles; Give the Drummer Some (2020).

title: Modern Drummer, Cindy Blackman: The Lady Comes To Play (April 2008)
notes: Tony on Four & More; 'I'm chasing the legends of Art Blakey, Tony Williams, and Elvin Jones'; 'You better smack those drums'; a 1950s Gretsch round-badge Broadkaster.

title: Bart Elliott, Cindy Blackman's Smooth Struttin' New Awlins Gumbo (Drummer Cafe, 2015)
notes: The groove she played at the start of her Vic Firth Interview Spotlight: a gallop on the ride, ghosts in the left hand, a kick and hat-foot ostinato.

title: DRUM! Magazine, Lenny Kravitz drummers, studio and live
notes: Via search summary: her only studio performance with Kravitz is 'Straight Cold Player' on 5 (1998); Kravitz plays most instruments on his records himself.

title: Africa Speaks (album) - Wikipedia
notes: Rick Rubin, ten days at Shangri-La, 49 songs; Cindy Blackman Santana on drums; Breaking Down the Door the first single, 19 April 2019.

title: Blessings and Miracles - Wikipedia
notes: Drums on all but tracks 4 (Joy: Derek Mixon) and 7.
